content.section1: I'm a person with many skills, especially in web development, which I'm currently studying. I often work independently and can handle most tasks on my own, but I also enjoy working in groups when needed. My social skills allow me to communicate easily with others, though I sometimes take a couple of months to remember people's names.
content.section2: My personal hobbies are closely related to my education - I spend much of my free time programming, mainly developing games on platforms like Roblox, Minecraft, and Steam.
